entities.title: A semantic outcome is thrown inside an operation and returned at its boundary
entities.summary: Deep inside an operation, an invalid or unsupported input is thrown as an internal OpFailure; Op.Run (and the typed layer) catch it and return it as a status, so no caller ever sees it as an exception.
entities.context: Every everyday operation checks its arguments in many places (structure, calendar, date, time fields, zone, rules). Operations never throw for semantic outcomes (docs/everyday-api.md, Results).
entities.decision: OpFailure carries a UtvStatus and its diagnostics. Op.Run wraps each JSON-layer operation, and Typed.Catch, Typed.ToOutcome and Interop's Convert do the same for the typed layer and native conversions.
entities.rationale: The checks can stop an operation at the first failure without threading a result through every helper, and the public contract still holds: the class comment says it never escapes the library.
